assistant.name: Smart Channels Digital Employee
assistant.open: Open the Smart Channels Digital Employee
assistant.welcome: Welcome to Smart Channels. I'm the Smart Channels Digital Employee — a digital assistant, not a human. I can take your enquiry and make sure the right engineer follows up personally. May I have your name?
assistant.askCompany: Thank you, {name}. Which company or organisation are you with?
assistant.askPhone: What's the best phone number to reach you on?
assistant.askEmail: And your email address, so our team can reply to you?
assistant.askService: Which service is your enquiry about?
assistant.askMessage: Tell me briefly what you need — a few sentences are perfect.
assistant.askConsent: Before I record your enquiry, one confirmation:
assistant.consentText: By submitting your details, you agree that Smart Channels may contact you regarding your enquiry.
assistant.declined: Understood — nothing has been recorded. You can reach our team directly at {phone} or {email}, and I'm here whenever you'd like to continue.
assistant.done: Thank you, {name} — your enquiry has been recorded (reference {ref}). Our team will contact you soon.
assistant.failed: I couldn't record your enquiry just now — nothing was sent. Please try again, or reach our team directly at {email}.
assistant.handoff: Just to be clear — I'm a digital assistant, not a human. To talk to a person right away, call {phone} or email {email}. Or continue here and a member of our team will follow up personally.
assistant.errEmail: That doesn't look like a valid email address — could you check it?
assistant.errPhone: That doesn't look like a valid phone number — could you check it?
assistant.errEmpty: Could you type a short reply so I can continue?
